## Why meet with SmartHelio® at RE+?


Managing solar and BESS assets means dealing with faults, performance losses, and time-consuming operational tasks. Let’s talk about how SmartHelio can help your team tackle these challenges.


### BESS: Get more insight into battery operations


Managing battery storage brings new operational challenges. SmartHelio helps teams monitor and understand asset performance, supporting better-informed decisions across solar and BESS portfolios.


### GAIA: Simplify everyday operations


GAIA is SmartHelio’s AI agent for solar and BESS operations. It helps teams investigate plant issues, automate reporting, and streamline operational workflows, so they can spend less time on repetitive tasks.


### Autopilot: Find and understand performance issues


Autopilot uses physics-informed AI predictive analytics


to detect underperformance, localise faults, and identify opportunities to recover lost energy and revenue.


## Let’s meet in Las Vegas!


Visit SmartHelio at **Booth W15860** to talk about your solar and BESS challenges and see what we’re working on.
